service.en: Passport renewal for UAE citizens abroad
service.ar: تجديد جواز سفر المواطنين المقيمين بالخارج
service.ur: بیرون ملک اماراتی شہریوں کے پاسپورٹ کی تجدید

about: Renew a UAE passport from abroad, collecting it at a UAE embassy.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE citizens living outside the country
Passport expired or valid for one year or less
documents: Recent personal photo meeting ICAO standards
Embassy letter confirming why you are abroad
timing: Collect the passport at the chosen UAE embassy
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
